info.name: Generative Marketing Collateral API
info.description:
ML6 Case 2 — two-endpoint API: upload two companies' context PDFs, then generate a tailored, factually-grounded B2B article as layout-valid structured JSON.

BASE URL is preset to the deployed Cloud Run service (edit the `baseUrl` collection variable for local: http://localhost:8000).

AUTH: in demo mode no token is needed. When the service runs with AUTH_MODE=google, set the `token` collection variable to a Google ID token:
  gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences={{baseUrl}}
(The collection sends it as a Bearer token on every request.)

TYPICAL FLOW:
  1. Upload sender PDF  (pick sample_data/sender_nimbus_ai.pdf)
  2. Upload receiver PDF (pick sample_data/receiver_vanguard_freight.pdf)
  3. Get briefs — poll until both sender and receiver are non-null
  4. Generate — returns the full ArticleJSON directly (synchronous; no polling)

request.description: Upload the SENDER company's PDF. In the 'files' form field, choose sample_data/sender_nimbus_ai.pdf. Parsed asynchronously into a typed brief; returns a job_id. (Enable the X-Tenant-ID header to exercise multi-tenancy.)
Upload the RECEIVER company's PDF. In the 'files' form field, choose sample_data/receiver_vanguard_freight.pdf.
Returns the stored sender/receiver briefs. Poll until BOTH are non-null before generating.

exec: if (!id && j && Array.isArray(j.blocks)) { var b = j.blocks.filter(function(x){ return x.image_ref; })[0]; if (b) { id = b.image_ref; } }
console.log('synchronous generate: ArticleJSON returned; saved pair_id, job_id (meta.request_id), first asset_id');

body.raw: {"pair_id": "{{pair_id}}", "prompt": "Show how Nimbus cuts Vanguard's idle fleet hours and improves on-time delivery", "template_id": "one_pager_v1"}

query.description: enable to run in the background -> 202 + job_id; then use request 5 to poll

request.description: The brief's second endpoint. Synchronous by default: returns the full ArticleJSON in the response (blocks, confidence, constraints, faithfulness, token/cost) — no polling needed. A test script saves pair_id, the request_id (as job_id) and the first asset_id so the other requests just work. Enable the Idempotency-Key header to make retries reuse the same result. For long/bursty jobs, enable the `async=true` query param to get 202 + job_id and poll with request 5.
